task.requirements: Implement ASCII slugs: lowercase letters, keep digits, collapse each run of other characters to one hyphen, strip leading/trailing hyphens. Empty input or punctuation-only input yields an empty string. Repeated separators must collapse. Add at least three meaningful unittest tests in test_feature.py; tests must catch the behavior regression described by this requirement.

validation_files.host_accept.sh:
# Evaluation 02: the Xcode launcher uses blocked posix_spawn; invoke the
# interpreter directly without weakening process-group containment.
python=python3
if command -v xcode-select >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    developer=$(xcode-select -p)
    native="$developer/Library/Frameworks/Python3.framework/Versions/Current/Resources/Python.app/Contents/MacOS/Python"
    if test -x "$native"; then python="$native"; fi
fi
"$python" -B host_validate.py

safety.scope_reason: Self-contained local fixture: modify only declared paths, preserve owner files and Git state; no external services, production credentials or externally visible side effects are required.

task.requirements: Implement moving averages of complete consecutive windows. Reject nonpositive window size with ValueError. Return no partial windows, return [] when the input is shorter than the window, and do not mutate values. Add at least three meaningful unittest tests in test_feature.py; tests must catch the behavior regression described by this requirement.

task.requirements: Implement an in-memory integer ledger. New idempotency keys apply delta once. Repeating the same key and delta returns the current balance without reapplying. Reusing a key with a different delta raises ValueError without changing balance. Distinct instances are independent. Add at least three meaningful unittest tests in test_feature.py; tests must catch the behavior regression described by this requirement.
